_meta.description: Curated secondhand-fashion trend notes keyed by style tag. This is the data source for the get_trend_info tool. Tags mirror the style_tags used in listings.json so any listing can be matched to a trend note.

vintage.note: Vintage pieces are peaking right now — true-to-era cuts and natural fading read as the most authentic look this season.

y2k.note: Y2K is still surging: low-rise bottoms, baby tees, and shiny fabrics are everywhere on resale right now.

90s.note: 90s minimalism and slip silhouettes are climbing — pair clean lines with chunky accessories for the current take.

grunge.note: Grunge is back in rotation: layered flannels, band tees, and combat boots are trending for an effortless undone vibe.

streetwear.note: Streetwear stays strong — oversized fits and graphic pieces remain a reliable resale staple.

cottagecore.note: Cottagecore is having a soft-girl revival: florals, linen, and crochet are trending into warmer months.

graphic tee.note: Graphic and band tees are a top resale search this season — worn-in prints sell fastest.

band tee.note: Authentic band tees are a coveted resale category right now; faded originals command the most attention.

denim.note: Denim is evergreen, but baggy and straight-leg cuts are leading over skinny fits this season.

athletic.note: Sporty 2000s-era track and warm-up pieces are trending as everyday wear.

minimal.note: Quiet, minimal basics stay in demand for capsule-wardrobe shoppers.

earth tones.note: Earth-tone palettes are trending for the season — browns, olives, and rust mix easily into existing wardrobes.

default.note: Secondhand staples in good condition are always in demand — focus on fit and versatility.
